display_name: Apnea-Hypopnea Index: (Apneas with >= 5% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and >= 5% oxygen desaturation and with or without arousal) / hour of sleep from type I polysomnography
calculation: 60*(hrembp5 + hrop5 + hnrbp5 + hnrop5 + carbp5 + carop5 + canbp5 + canop5 + oarbp5 + oarop5 + oanbp5 + oanop5 + marbp5 + marop5 + manrbp5 + manrop5)/slpprdp
